workflow.description: Audited workflow requires managed Codex with two explicit, different models. Orca uses execution.settings.agent_launch.model and the trusted execution-host runtime. Omitted audit effort inherits the normalized execution effort.

model_input_contract.caller: body override, instruction, inline materials, schema, answer, feedback; escaped data remains caller
model_input_contract.measurement: all new model-visible text in one native dispatch after framing/newline handling; null byte limits mean no text budget; only Runner-generated text is capped; no truncation, summarization or automatic splitting; checked text is frozen and verified before send

native.answers: caller text; native JSON question IDs/framing are Runner; same-ask/turn binding unchanged

ask_tool.description: Ask only necessary human decisions; group related questions, offer clear options and wait for answers.
ask_tool.name: steerline_ask

native.authentication: Authentication set; no env/credential/config/header dumps, login, auth/permission changes, escalation or uncertain publication repeats.
native.bootstrap: Initialize this agent session. Reply READY only. Do not use tools or change files.
native.content_session: Read-only: use submitted directory/frozen materials; return content. No writes, commits, push or PR. Ask via steerline_ask.
native.initialization: Initialize: READY only, no tools/changes. This rule ends after READY; later/compacted turns complete the current task.
native_rejections: Runner rejected an unsupported or malformed native question.
Runner cannot authorize this native host request.
Initialization permits no tools or approvals.
native.worker: shell=%q,login=false。临时文件限本次 AppContainer 工具临时目录并同次清理，禁写认证/Git管理根。不得输出环境/凭据、提权、登录、改认证或权限。仅精确暂存任务路径，检查非空暂存diff且仅含任务；串行暂存/检查/提交，非零即停。commit不用管道，紧接命令保存并打印其$LASTEXITCODE，再查状态。Git2.55仅删除缺失AUTO_MERGE产生packed-refs.lock告警时：退出0且HEAD前进、父提交/路径正确、worktree干净、无merge/cherry-pick/revert状态，报告告警后继续，不重试提交或修清理。其余失败/未知含认证过期、沙箱拒绝，保留原分支/PR结果并停止对账；未知发布不重做。

parser.boundary: Only organize provided audit output as data. No tools, inspection, tests, repair, commit or publication. Preserve partial/unknown facts; never infer zero or success.
parser.evidence: complete JSON-encoded original final; unattempted oversized parser uses existing report fallback
parser.format: Return one JSON object matching the native schema; unknown optional fields=null. done requires completed audit/validation, no remaining P0-P2.

model_input_contract.runner: default body, labels/separators/newlines, dynamic facts/references, result format, completion, native model/header framing, developer and Runner tool descriptions, parser source text

dsh_tool_descriptions.Text: Execute Windows PowerShell 5.1 in the fixed workspace. Use it for files, Git, tests and publication. Commands use the frozen native permissions and repository authentication; approval escalation is unavailable.

terminal.headers: existing native-command/terminal-extension: command+input digest; native-model: original base64 JSON command/input/body digests/step/model/effort; all header bytes are Runner
terminal.normalization: existing CRLF to LF and trailing CR/LF removal; physical bracketed-paste control bytes are transport
terminal.pi: Runner adds no model instruction or tool description; original SDK tools unchanged

model_input_contract.tool_file_results: not new input text unless copied into it; existing file channels only, references must resolve in execution workspace

transport.orca: actual CLI argv protected independently; remote RPC envelope not exposed by CLI

workflow.body: state.prompt; explicit prompt_overrides replaces only the original body, including audit.execute's default format
workflow.commit: 将完成的代码改动提交到当前分支。

content.material_frame: JSON array: content (escaped caller text), path, sha256 (Runner framing and facts)
content.repository: Investigate only fixed read-only snapshot; no writes/commits/PRs/Tasks/DAGs. Return document paths as logical JSON, use caller Roadmap codes; cite source paths and commit/tree:
content.schema: Return one JSON value matching schema, no fences:

workflow.facts: report source=original command_id, optional failure; exact turn/version/digest and audit/publication prerequisites stay program-verified, never internal ledgers
workflow.materials: implementation execute: Spec/Plan and distinct reference paths in the original worktree

progress.text: STEERLINE_PROGRESS_FILE: raw<=65536B; lock/read-merge then same-dir temp+atomic replace. Runner preserves bytes, not semantics.
progress.when: enabled implementation/audit execute only; reuse rule only if already supplied in this original session

project_policies.when: only state.policy_slots with exists=true in the frozen project commit; Runner input budget; no inline content

publication.label: PR target:
publication.slots: execute only: provider/repository/base_url/remote/base; no provider query or authentication configuration

result_file.text: STEERLINE_RESULT_FILE: independent raw<=65536B; coordinate writers, same-dir atomic replace. Sealed once after execution/producers stop, never turn end/pr_ready; not a success signal.
result_file.when: enabled implementation/audit execute only; reuse rule only if already supplied in this original session

workflow.result_format: report state.result_instruction remains fixed; audit execute format remains part of overridable body

parser_support.reason: codex-parser/v1: native read-only/never, independent provided-text session; zero tools is a behavior contract with post-event rejection, not an empty-tool guarantee

progress_file.delivery: latest stable complete snapshot; intermediate writes may coalesce
progress_file.path_boundary: fixed original host/worktree/relative file; no arbitrary caller paths or directory scan; adversarial link replacement races are outside this contract
progress_file.retention: last snapshot retained after stop; state-dir required
progress_file.version: persistent independent monotonic content version; does not change Run revision

result_file.delivery: final-only: at most one snapshot after original execution ended and producers stopped; no running collection or query reads; bounded by 2 seconds and lifecycle deadline; failed seal is final; resume never refreshes
result_file.path_boundary: fixed original host/worktree/relative file; no arbitrary caller paths or directory scan; adversarial link replacement races are outside this contract
result_file.retention: sealed success or failure retained after stop and restart; state-dir required
result_file.version: 0 until successful seal, then 1 forever; does not change Run revision

result_file_schema.description: Final-only opaque file snapshot; collected after original execution ends and producers stop. No running collection or reads on query. First seal is permanent, including failure.

run_cost.pricing_policy: explicit_absolute_json_file; no built-in prices or network fetch

collection.publication: producer publishes a complete file (temp + rename), then caller explicitly collects
collection.discovery: recursive regular files; links rejected; directory must exist
collection.request: v1 write envelope with expected_revision and relative_path
collection.identity: new artifact_id per new collect request; same request_id replays original receipt
collection.storage: immutable bytes in original Run managed evidence record; retained after stop and workspace cleanup

read.retention: requires retained state-dir and resident service; no workspace required

git.coherence: two identical porcelain v2 branch/status samples bracketing original workspace identity checks; fsmonitor/untracked cache disabled; detected changes yield unverified; transient change-and-revert between samples cannot be proven absent

relative_path.description: POSIX path relative to .steerrunner/artifacts; no dot segments, backslash, colon, controls, trailing dot/space or links.

run_usage.support_scope: implementation; live qualification is recorded separately

workflows.description: Implement and publish a verified PR.

implement.execute.prompt: 读取所列 Spec/Plan/材料，实施并完成必要验证。
implement.execute.success_output: 实施及必要验证已完成。

implement.report.prompt: 仅整理原实施结果，不补做；保留依据、失败、未知、缺失与冲突。

publish.execute.prompt: 发布当前分支并创建 PR；用 git branch --show-current 确定 head。返回真实 PR URL；结果未知时说明并停止，不重复发布。

publish.report.result_instruction: JSON only: outcome=done|needs_input|blocked,summary; needs_input:question; blocked:blocker{category=failure|unknown_external|permission|prerequisite,action,error,known?,unknown?}. done: outputs:{pr_url:actual PR URL}.
publish.report.prompt: 仅整理原发布结果与 PR URL，不重发；保留依据、失败、未知、缺失与冲突。

workflows.description: Implement, audit and repair code once, then publish the verified revision.

audit.code.execute.prompt:
审计修复 P0–P2；必要验证后提交，无改动沿用提交。
JSON only: outcome=done|needs_input|blocked,summary; needs_input:question; blocked:blocker{category=failure|unknown_external|permission|prerequisite,action,error,known?,unknown?}. fixed_count>=0=len(fixed_issues); severity=P0|P1|P2; fixed_issues:[{severity,issue,repair,evidence}],remaining_issues:[{severity,issue,reason}]. done: audit+validation complete,remaining_issues=[]. Keep partial/unknown; never invent facts or 0/[].
